name: b2_dma_mv_regkq_esl_ref-regkq-look-COMMIT
purpose: New request/mover leaf for the B2 DMA cluster; pin file from die lead pending. Production FRONT0 and closed KV siblings. BACK1 remains separate closed NB8 leaf; unified local8 VM port pending die interface publication. Exact gate also compares every port request payload/ordering to unchanged flat source. Six separate seam mutants bind skid, I-list, group OR, HBM lane mux, compact bank lane, qid. Production class has no simulator price row; rates measured against immutable flat, not re-priced.

structural_change: Distinct source successor: core sector FFs clear invalid payload and expose full registered KQ; original group_q edge moved into independent two-seam group face with no added request edge. MV receives only32 registered valid credit bits. WQ existing control replication ESL32 preserves queue edges and reservations.
